explanation_full: Observations show that the KNN model significantly outperforms other benchmark models, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318. The analysis also highlights that VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate are the top three features correlated with HPR. Furthermore, the sequence diagnostics for KNN indicate a high sequence correlation of 0.931488. These findings suggest that the model is robustly trained on key chemical indicators, though the prediction time diagnostics are limited to the provided summary.
